patch_description:
Add deterministic directed coordinate proposals derived from the area gradients of the currently smallest triangles incident to the point being updated. The existing search samples only random directions, despite already identifying the complete lower tail of the triangle-area spectrum. For a fixed point, each signed triangle determinant has a simple linear gradient; summing the ascent gradients of the tight incident constraints gives a local maximin-inspired direction that tends to expand several limiting triangles simultaneously.

Three of the random proposals are replaced by short, medium, and long moves along this lower-tail gradient. Random and broad exploration proposals remain available, while late coordinate polishing is unchanged. This should improve the probability that each sweep finds a genuine bottleneck-improving direction without increasing the number of triangle evaluations.
